name: Scroll Theme Switch
description: Sections declare data-theme="dark" or "light" and a tiny IntersectionObserver script mirrors whichever section dominates the viewport onto the html element, so CSS custom properties crossfade the whole page (fixed header included) between a bone-light and a near-black theme as you scroll.
usage: Link styles.css, give each full-width section data-theme="dark" or data-theme="light", paint your page with the --ts-* tokens, and load script.js (it auto-runs, or call initThemeSwitch() yourself). Any number of sections works, and without JS the page stays in the light theme.
source: Pattern seen on https://coffee-tech.com (Awwwards SOTD by MAKETHECUT and Or Halevi), implemented from scratch
